readings._multiplicity: readings B to F were written after the declared read A returned a negative pi_hat. Reading F clears it as a point estimate and is recorded as a CANDIDATE, not as a pass -- see F_by_ranking_month and F_interval.

yield_of_the_declared_check.face_is_a_projection: the shipped rung's worth per TRUE row applied to D's true rows; it is not a fold measurement, and only surfacefit's refit could make it one

day_placebo_validity.reading: the +24 h shift destroys the clock completely and barely touches the geography: on check (iii) the day placebo passes at a rate ABOVE the refused pool's.  It lands the departure on the same recurring service one day later, so it preserves the invariant D reads.  It is a null for a clock check, which is what §27 used it for, and it is NOT a null for check D

the_runway_clause_is_check_ii.reading: the service's modal runway IS the row's own RUNWAY_mvt on 98.7 % of the shipped rows and 98.4 % of the refused, so D's runway clause is check (ii) re-derived from other days.  It is independent by construction and a copy in fact, and the refused pool fails (ii) on most of its rows, so the clause can only suppress the yield

coverage_of_the_stand_clause.reading: the stand clause fires on only 57 % of the SHIPPED rows at a p95 tolerance, and the shortfall is coverage, not tolerance: the modal stand has no centroid in a map learned from 3,179 rows.  A wider map would raise t and q together

verdict.declared_reading: FAIL: pi_hat is negative -- the declared check D fires LESS often on the refused pool (0.1309) than on the harsher placebo (0.2250), so it finds no excess of true placements there
verdict.why_it_failed: two causes, both measured: D's runway clause is check (ii) re-derived from other days (the service's modal runway is the row's own RUNWAY_mvt on 98.7 % of the shipped rows), and the day placebo is not a null for a service check (a +24 h shift lands on the same service the next day and passes the shipped stand check at 0.8895, above the refused pool's 0.8397)
verdict.after_the_repair: the repair the diagnosis asks for -- drop the runway clause, widen the stand centroid map, and read only the rows that fail the clock alone -- is reading F_stand_half_wider_map_clock_only_sub_pool: precision 0.9052 on 774 rows, point estimate above the bar 0.896, interval [0.8741, 0.931], and 0.7315 of the day-clustered draws at or above the bar
verdict.handshake: no rows go to surfacefit's fold refit on this section.  The DECLARED check fails; the variant whose point estimate clears the bar was chosen after five tries on the same pool it is priced on, which is the error class round 6 failed on.  The handshake needs a pre-registered read, which this lane can write and the desk can call.
